state.goal: Classify each support record and prioritize a review queue; do not send replies or change accounts.

categories.billing: Charges, invoices and refunds, including resolved payment questions.
categories.bug: Product failures, including sign-in errors when identity is already verified.
categories.how_to: Requests for instructions when no product failure is reported.
categories.unknown: No category fits or the supplied record is insufficient.

urgency_levels: Routine or resolved; no current blocked work is reported.
An active issue remains, but a usable workaround lets work continue.
Current work is blocked with no known workaround, requiring immediate investigation.
policy.account_review: Account-specific checks are needed to resolve an open issue; a closed issue with an observed resolution does not need another check.

thread.text: My invoice seems to show two charges. Please investigate.
We checked the payment receipt: one captured charge and one temporary authorization. The authorization was released.
Confirmed, the duplicate has disappeared. Thank you.

observations.source: synthetic payment receipt and customer confirmation

thread.text: Our whole team gets a server error signing in, so we cannot open the project needed for today's workshop.
Identity is verified. Try the alternative sign-in page while we investigate.
Still not working. The alternative page has the same error for everyone.

missing_evidence: Server-side cause has not been investigated.
